children: Crane Harbor Acquisition Corp. II reported a swing to net income from a year-earlier loss, as $3.2M of interest earned on trust-account cash and investments more than offset $188,104 in general and administrative costs. The company remains pre-combination and has not begun operations or generated operating revenue.
: Cash and investments held in the account totaled $354.8M at September 30, 2026.
: The company continued identifying a target for a business combination; it expects no operating revenue until after a combination, at the earliest.
: Cash outside the trust account was $1.6M, and management said it believes available funds can meet working-capital needs for one year.
